diagnosis.reference: On user1, the default route was replaced by a prohibit (discard) route: every lookup for a non-local destination is refused, so it cannot reach other subnets.

commands: ip route add default via 10.10.10.1 dev eth1
changes.reason: user1's kernel route table shows 'prohibit default' instead of a default route via 10.10.10.1 (leaf1's users_vlan gateway, confirmed up with 10.10.10.1/24). Every other endpoint on the lab has a matching 'default via <gateway>' entry, and guest1/web1 cross-leaf paths work, so the missing default route on user1 is the only anomaly that would block user1's pings to web1 and app1 while leaving web1/app1→user1 (and other cross-leaf paths) intact.

commands: ip route replace default via 10.10.10.1 dev eth1
changes.reason: 'ip route add' failed with EEXIST because 'prohibit default' occupies the 0.0.0.0/0 prefix in the main table; 'replace' will swap it for the correct default route via leaf1's users_vlan gateway, matching the configuration every other endpoint uses.
